patterns.note: The primary content (brand name, tagline, description) is left-aligned and centrally placed, creating a strong focal point against the dominant background.
An extremely large, bold, uppercase sans-serif typeface is used for the main brand name 'NINE SIXTY', making it the most prominent visual element.
A single, vibrant royal blue serves as the overwhelming background color, creating high contrast with the black text and white icon.
The page is structured with a prominent hero section featuring the brand name, a concise description, and an illustrative image, followed by a large typographic scroll element at the bottom.
A large, partially visible 'SAY HELLO' text string at the bottom suggests a horizontal scroll or parallax effect, implying dynamic content interaction.

technique_notes: To achieve the dominant brand name, use a large viewport-relative font size with a heavy font-weight and minimal letter-spacing for a bold, impactful headline.
Implement a full-page background with a single, high-saturation color to create a strong brand identity and visual anchor for contrasting text and graphic elements.

Overlay a simple, geometric white icon (like the triangle) centrally on a featured image, using transparency or blend modes to ensure it stands out while allowing the background image to remain visible.
